# Calling a partner, once it has greeted this side with its SID and prompt
# (see forward.Calling): this side sends its own SID, and the partner's next
# prompt starts this side's turn.  Its
# end hands over.  Having made the connection, this side says F> rather than
# its prompt after each message it takes, as LinBPQ does; the partner's turn
# ends with *** DONE.
@queued SP Q1TEST @ Q2BBS < Q9TEST $5_Q1BBS
@calling [FBB-7.0-ABFHM$]
< [SAMBBS-0.0-H$]
> Q2BBS>
< SP Q1TEST @ Q2BBS < Q9TEST $5_Q1BBS
> OK
< Title 1
< R:261031/1200Z @:Q1BBS.#77.GBR.EURO
< Body 1.
< /EX
> Q2BBS>
< F>
> SP Q1TEST @ Q1BBS < Q9TEST $40_Q2BBS
< OK
> Back to you
> Hi.
> /EX
< F>
> *** DONE
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=1 forwarded=1 refused=0 pending=0
